runPlan.archetype: AOE/Whirlwind attack deck, no strength: add strength, draw, block
runPlan.potionTempo: Slots are empty: take damage/strength/block potions and hold them for the Sandpit boss; drink one in any hallway that would otherwise drop us below ~35% HP.
runPlan.tempo: At 30/80 skip every optional elite, take hallways/shops, heal at rests until ~65% then smith. Spend the 414 gold on strength, AOE and Strike removal. Board the boss at 85%+ with potions.
runPlan.bossPrep: Permanent strength (Inflame/Demon Form), upgraded Whirlwind/Bash, a damage and a block potion; play every affordable Frantic Escape, never wait for sandpit ≤2.
runPlan.summary: Preserve HP: skip elites, heal at rests, spend 414 gold on strength/AOE and Strike removal; stack damage/block potions, board the Sandpit boss at 85%+, play every affordable Frantic Escape.
disagreements: disagreement (kept): route_risk avoid_elites while the plan needs strength and the boss clock reads the deck ~18/turn of 53 for THE_INSATIABLE (gap 35, at 38% HP): elites' relics and rare cards are where that scaling comes from; kept (code does not force elites)

fightPlan.threat: After BURROW it gains 32 retained block, then BELOW hits 23 every turn; grinding through that block bleeds the run.
fightPlan.summary: Race the Tunneler: attack every turn, block only enough for BITE 13 / BELOW 23, and on the burrow turn push 32+ damage to break its block before the 23s start.
fightPlan.potionPlan: Slots are empty and this hallway is not worth a boss potion; take any potion reward and hold damage/block potions for the Sandpit boss.
